project_analysis.root_selected: declared library/corpus root from public workspace context

reason_model.recommended_reason_code: MEDIA_CORPUS_ROOT_HANDOFF_READY when inventory entities exist; MEDIA_CORPUS_ROOT_NO_INVENTORY_ELIGIBLE_ENTITIES when they do not

questions_answered.1_root_selected: The latest R2.8 public run selected the declared corpus/library root as the ProjectAnalysis workspace.
questions_answered.2_root_role: The public prompt/context carried the root as a library/corpus role, but ProjectAnalysisRequest did not receive that structured context before this patch.
questions_answered.3_root_role_classified_as_media_corpus: No, not inside ProjectAnalysis before this patch.
questions_answered.4_source_readable_selection_applied_to_m: Yes. PathGuard text-read extension policy rejected media files as extension_not_allowed.
questions_answered.6_inventory_eligible_count: Expected to be nonzero for governed library/corpus media entities; before patch it was not counted at ProjectAnalysis.
questions_answered.10_handoff_not_used: ProjectAnalysis lacked workspace_context root-role semantics and FileSelection lacked inventory eligibility counters.
questions_answered.12_separate_eligibility: ReadableSourceSelection remains governed by text-read PathGuard; InventoryEligibleEntitySelection counts corpus candidates for artifact runtime without reading them as text.
questions_answered.13_extension_not_truth: Extension is recorded only as a capability routing hint, never codec/container/tag truth.
questions_answered.14_keep_generic_degraded: PROJECT_ANALYSIS_DEGRADED remains available for truly degraded projects without a more specific handoff reason.
questions_answered.16_artifact_runtime_without_success: ProjectAnalysis returns partial safe_to_continue with limitations and reason; later artifact/runtime/semantic policies still decide success or block.
questions_answered.17_preserve_r2_7_r2_8: No changes to terminality guard or sharded artifact registry write path.
questions_answered.18_cvl_update: CVL now recognizes media corpus handoff and root-role/file-selection mismatch frontiers.

patch_plan: Add workspace_context to ProjectAnalysisRequest and pass it from public runtime.
Add root_role and inventory eligibility fields to FileSelectionRequest/Candidate/Plan.
Record media corpus inventory eligibility when PathGuard blocks only text-read extension.
Return MEDIA_CORPUS_ROOT_HANDOFF_READY partial ProjectAnalysisResult when corpus inventory entities exist but source-readable selection is empty.
Expose corpus_handoff in ProjectAnalysisResult and runtime analysis_payload.
